title: Chain representative for ordinary pro-etale module cohomology pullback
statement:
Let $h:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], constant coefficient sheaves $A_X,A_Y$ and the canonical structure isomorphism $h^{-1}A_Y\cong A_X$ [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. Write $h^*\dashv h_*$ and $Lh^*\dashv Rh_*$ for the module adjunctions of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]; $h^*$ is exact and $Lh^*$ is its termwise derived functor. For $T=X,Y$, let $\Gamma_T$ be global sections of module sheaves, valued in $A$-modules, and define $R\Gamma_T(Q_TK)=Q_A\Gamma_T I(K)$ using K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex, prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], where $Q_T$ and $Q_A$ are localization of cochain complexes at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $I$ be a K-injective complex of $A_Y$-modules, $J$ a K-injective complex of $A_X$-modules, and $j:h^*I\to J$ any chain map. Denote the canonical comparisons by $a_I:R\Gamma_Y(Q_YI)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_A\Gamma_YI$, $a_J:R\Gamma_X(Q_XJ)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_A\Gamma_XJ$ and $c_I:Lh^*(Q_YI)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_X(h^*I)$. Let $e_{h,F}:\Gamma_YF\to\Gamma_X(h^*F)$ be the sheaf-adjunction unit followed by the terminal-object identification $\Gamma_Yh_*\cong\Gamma_X$, and put $w=\Gamma_X(j)\circ e_{h,I}$, degree by degree. Write $\eta_h$ for the derived adjunction unit and $\lambda_{h,N}:R\Gamma_Y(Rh_*N)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma_XN$ for the canonical derived terminal-object (Leray) identification. Then the following equality holds in $D(A)$:
$$
 a_J^{-1}\circ Q_A(w)\circ a_I
 =R\Gamma_X(Q_X(j)\circ c_I)\circ\lambda_{h,Lh^*(Q_YI)}\circ R\Gamma_Y(\eta_{h,Q_YI}).
$$
No quasi-isomorphism hypothesis on $j$ is required.

proof.text: Write L=h^*, F=h_*, G=Gamma_Y, H=Gamma_X, a for the recorded module adjunction and e:F composed with G isomorphic to H for the already constructed terminal-section identification. The exactness and adjunction in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] imply by [lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective] that F preserves K-injectives. Apply the existing proved generic composition construction [lem-fin-kinjective-derived-composition] to this e. Its defining rightDerivedUnique factorization and rightDerivedNatTrans_fac give beta_FG followed by lambda = Qh(e) followed by beta_H, where beta_FG is the composite unit for RF composed with RG. This is the private lemma unitLerayFac; no choice of a terminal ringed-site presentation is needed.

source.place: Tags 07A6, 08J6 and 0D6E; generic unbounded derived-adjunction and composition unit compatibilities in derived.tex Tag 0FND

proof.text: For any homotopy complex K on Y, use [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy] and Mathlib Adjunction.derivedη_fac_app for its canonical derived adjunction: eta_D at Qh K followed by RF(c_K) equals Qh(eta_K) followed by beta_F at L K. Move RH(c_K) through lambda by naturality. Apply RG to the displayed equation and use naturality of beta_G on eta_K. The composite-unit equation of step 1 then gives beta_G at K followed by RG(eta_D) followed by lambda followed by RH(c_K) = Qh(G(eta_K) followed by e at L K) followed by beta_H at L K. This is unitLerayHomotopy. It holds without any K-injectivity assumption on K or L K.

source.place: Tags 07A6, 08J6 and 0D6E; generic unbounded derived-adjunction and composition unit compatibilities in derived.tex Tag 0FND

proof.text: Take K to be the homotopy quotient of I. Postcompose the equation of step 2 by RH(Q(j)). Naturality of beta_H for the homotopy class of j moves this factor to Qh(H(j)) followed by beta_H at J. The termwise adjunction unit is the homotopy class of the chain unit, so the resulting localized composite is Q(w) followed by beta_H at J, with w equal to the specified degreewise section-unit map followed by H(j). No invertibility of j is used. The exact-functor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization] and its quotient normalization identify c_K with mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom at I.

source.place: Tags 07A6, 08J6 and 0D6E; generic unbounded derived-adjunction and composition unit compatibilities in derived.tex Tag 0FND

proof.text: On the K-injective complexes I and J, the already proved source construction Functor.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso is the inverse of the respective rightDerivedFunctorUnit, conjugated by quotientCompQhIso. Expand only these canonical comparison isomorphisms, whose quotient comparison components are identities on representatives. Precompose the equality of step 3 by the inverse beta_G at I, cancel beta_G, and use functoriality and associativity. This gives a_I followed by Q(w) followed by a_J inverse = RG(eta_D) followed by lambda followed by RH(c_I followed by Q(j)), exactly the required statement. The proof is unitLerayChain for arbitrary abelian categories and is specialized to the recorded pro-etale functors in the final theorem. No assertion that L(I) is K-injective is needed.
